sources.primary_title: Cloudflare to spotlight AI Security and Agentic Infrastructure Vision at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, Cloudflare is showcasing its vision for securing AI workloads and managing agentic infrastructure. The company is highlighting tools like Cloudflare One for Zero Trust, Firewall for AI to prevent prompt injections, and AI Gateway for traffic control. A major focus is on securing autonomous AI agents, treating them with the same identity and permission rigor as human users. Ercan Aydin, Area Vice President for the Middle East, Turkey & Africa, emphasized that as Saudi Arabia moves AI into production, the need for secure, visible, and governed AI infrastructure becomes critical. This angle is distinct as it specifically addresses the emerging challenge of securing active AI agents rather than just passive AI models.
sources.verified_key_facts: Cloudflare is showcasing its AI security and agentic infrastructure vision at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh (August 31 - September 3); The company emphasizes the need to treat AI agents with strict identity and permission controls, similar to human users; Key technologies highlighted include Cloudflare One (Zero Trust), Cloudflare Workers, Firewall for AI, and AI Gateway; Cloudflare introduced AI Crawl Control and Pay Per Crawl to give publishers control over AI access to content; Ercan Aydin, Area VP for Middle East, Turkey & Africa, noted that Saudi Arabia is rapidly moving AI from experimentation to production; Cloudflare's H1 2026 DDoS Threat Report showed a surge in attacks reaching terabit-per-second ranges, underscoring the need for AI-driven defense.
